$comment: Which icon comes from where. `sheets`: the source images, under catalog/icons/. `icons`: one entry per icon; `sheet` names a sheet and `box` is [x, y, width, height] in that sheet's pixels (or `file` names an image that is the icon alone). `to` is the folder whose public/icons/ gets the full set (a course's folder, or `catalog`); an entry with no `to` is a candidate course and goes to catalog/icons/candidates/. Run `npm run icons` after changing anything here; tools/process-icons.mjs explains the outputs.
